summary: The foundations of retirement planning 101: what it is and why getting it right pays off.
body:

title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Retirement Planning 101
summary: Start retirement planning 101 this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Capture the full employer 401(k) match
2. Build emergency fund alongside
3. Open IRA (Roth if eligible)
4. Automate 15% total savings
5. Invest in low-cost index funds

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.

title: Common Retirement Planning 101 Mistakes and How to Avoid Them
summary: The mistakes everyone makes with retirement planning 101 — and the fixes.
body:
The classic errors:

- Skipping the match → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Market timing → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- High-fee funds → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Cashing out when changing jobs → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.

Every mistake above is cheap to prevent and expensive to repair. Prevention is the whole game.

title: Retirement Planning 101 Beginner FAQ
summary: Straight answers to the most common retirement planning 101 questions.
body:
Q: Roth or traditional?
A: Roth if young/lower income; traditional if high earner now.

Q: How much at 40?
A: Roughly 3x salary saved is a common benchmark.

Q: What if I start late?
A: Save more, work longer, spend less - all three help.

Still stuck? Start with record 2 of this guide and do the first move today.
